sources.title: Eagles waive defensive lineman
sources.description: The Eagles had their first off-day of training camp on Sunday, but the team did make one roster move, announcing that they waived defensive lineman Ta’Quon Graham. Graham was excused (not injury related) from Day 3 of practices on Saturday. He had been doing some cross training in the early days of camp, getting reps […]
